newsitem.title: MEXICO: Soft drink prices in Mexico raised - Notimex.
newsitem.headline: Soft drink prices in Mexico raised - Notimex.

text.p: Mexico raised soft drinks prices on Saturday by from 20 to 50 centavos, state news agency Notimex reported, quoting distributors.

It said brands like Coca-Cola, Pepsi-Cola and Orange Crush increased from 1.8 pesos to two pesos in half-liter bottles, from 2.8 pesos to 3.20 pesos for 1-1/2 liters, and from five pesos to 5.5 pesos in the two-liter size.
It gave no futher details, saying only that soft drinks prices were not subject to government control.
